entities.name: Numai
entities.description: A human settlement of stilt houses in the Takenuma swamp of Kamigawa; once a prosperous city, now a loose group of half-deteriorated buildings.

entities.name: Uramon
entities.description: Rich, powerful resident living in a restored manor house.

entities.name: Rat's Nest
entities.description: Filthy, sagging tavern on stilts in Numai.

entities.name: Mahotsukai cult
entities.description: Cult of powerful black jushi based in Numai during the Kami War.

entities.name: Kiku
entities.description: Greatest of the mahotsukai black jushi.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War during which Numai was the cult's base.

events.summary: During the Kami War Numai becomes the base of the mahotsukai cult.
events.quote: During the Kami War , it was the base of the mahotsukai cult

relations.quote: Numai (NOO-meye; lit. “swamp home”) is a human settlement in the Takenuma swamp of the plane of Kamigawa .
the greatest of which was Kiku
